jem_summary: Connect a distant inventory by cable and retrieve its item through the network terminal.

pages.title: Storage Around the Corner
pages.text: Connect a distant inventory by cable and retrieve its item through the network terminal.

pages.title: Storage Around the Corner
pages.text: Reach storage beyond one wall; cables and trims extend the network you demonstrated.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Cables join Cable Connectors; the network needs an Inventory Connector. Trims bridge nearby sections and a Proxy exposes its pointed inventory face.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use an Open Crate facing a block. Expose the front block as inventory interaction that creates item entities.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Run Inventory Cables between Cable Connectors attached to inventories and terminals. Connect distant inventories; the cable network must contain an Inventory Connector.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place an Inventory Proxy pointing toward the inventory face to expose. Use the proxy as an extension of that face.
